name: Carillon Hearth Belfry
core_rationale: Central ceramic-bell sanctuary town of Terracotta Wind-Chime Ridge at [1, 1] where Lantern-Keepers tune the thermal wind-organs above the Ceramic Resonator Crypt.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Warm terracotta resonance basins that ripple in concentric rings with every bell-chord

North.lock_message: Harmonic gale-shear across Flute-Crest Promontory buffets unshielded travelers; Carillon-Master Elian requires the Porcelain Tuning Fork before opening the northern promontory.

resident_npcs.name: Carillon-Master Elian
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Carillon Hearth Belfry! Step up to my 0.58 meter ceramic key-desk and listen to the evening thermal chord.

resident_npcs.name: Bell-Caster Sana
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Ceramic Resonator Crypt, an overwound carillon colossus guards the Porcelain Tuning Fork needed to open Flute-Crest Promontory!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Terracotta Wind-Chime Ridge at [1, 1] directly above Sola's Ceramic Resonator Crypt.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Glazed ceramic-bell sanctuary plaza where thermal breezes play pentatonic chords across water basins.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58m key-desks, 0.14m terracotta risers, 2.10m x 1.55m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Flute-Crest Promontory behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_message.
